minor: 'By most accounts, viewing it needed a separate playback unit wired to a television' has no sources entry. The listed sources only say the image appeared on a television screen. Add a source or soften the line to 'by Sasson's account'.
'Kodak's film profit was shrinking' (before the Health Group line) has no sources entry. The 2008-2011 net losses and the revenue series support it only indirectly.
'to raise cash' for the Health Group sale is an inferred motive. The source only reports the sale and price. Say 'Kodak sold...' without the motive, or add a source.
'Patents were the one asset still paying' is the script's own characterisation. The source only supports the Samsung settlement.
'It was really a video camera taking stills' is a simplification of the Mavica. It is acceptable as written.
The patent sale to 'a group including Apple, Google and Microsoft' compresses the structure. The buyers were consortia, and the listed source uses the same wording, so it is fine.
'Kodak joined the Dow in 1930' and 'after seventy-four years' are consistent with the sources (1930 to April 2004).
